subject: STABLE texture-opus P1+P1b (XR + multi-plane IOSurface sampled shadows) gate-green; HEAVY RELEASE; pausing shared-source edits for root's build
body: Gates on the current tree (incl. root commit 1ef65de): run_host_tests.sh NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin rc=0 'all offline GPU tests passed' (P1 tree, 59 PASS lines); after P1b: build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh PASS ARM64 full frontend; render harness PASS (stub+real); CA test c6f PASS 41 checks ASan+release; iosurface_cpu_test PASS; NEW texture_format_frontend_test PASS (XR_IMPORTS ok=4, PLANE_IMPORTS ok=4, XR draw status4, ASan); integration --candidate 1005 checks required_failures=2 = only the known CoreAnimation pass 66/42 (candidate_ok/native_compute_ok True). Files to commit (mine): gpu/metal/tegu/render_encoder.inc fb39a5b8 (NOTE: also contains encode-cpu-opus's uncommitted TEGU_PERF_BATCH pass-shape hunk @~4099 - commit together or ask encode), gpu/metal/tegu/compositor_submit.inc 08b094c9 (tegu_shadow_copy only), NEW gpu/metal/tegu/xr_decode_table.h c04699a9, NEW gpu/tools/gen_xr_decode_table.py 6f692b77, gpu/tests/iosurface_cpu_test.py 4e846e1d, NEW gpu/tests/texture_format_frontend_test.py 60971252. Snapshots+logs: gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p1-stable, p1b-stable. Behaviour: sampled-only (usage==1) IOSurface textures: XR formats 552/553/554/555 -> RGBA16F decode shadow (seed-gated re-decode, never written back, CPU access to surface); any plane of a multi-plane surface ('420v'/'420f'/'x420' Y R8|R16 + CbCr RG8|RG16, 'b3a8' plane0 BGR10_XR + plane1 A8/R8) -> per-plane shadow; Metal's rule bytes-per-element(plane)==format bpp via IOSurfaceGetBytesPerElement[OfPlane] (fourcc table fallback); '&...' lossless-compressed surfaces, unknown sizes, out-of-range planes refuse with TEGU_IOSURFACE_REFUSED reasons. NOT covered yet (explicit refusals unchanged): rendering INTO b3a8/XR/YUV surfaces, 8-bit sRGB textures in the generic path (translator SrgbTexture variant refused by generic_plan), ETC2/EAC/ASTC-HDR (profile), formats outside {1,10,30,43,70,80,115,ASTC} in tegu_generic_texture_ok/planner. Device: no claim; the shadows are the same CPU-copy class as existing LA08/BGRA shadows. HEAVY RELEASE. I will not edit shared sources until root says the build is done.
